note: The Sunrise scale for the user's own check-in values (decisions 149/150, specs/colour-roles.md section 1). Each value maps to a step 1-5; the step picks the colour. Rules are checked in order and the first whose conditions all hold wins ('eq' ==, 'lt' <, 'lte' <=; a rule with no condition matches any value). step null = neutral: muted, no colour. Never for journal text, moments, Moodbow's voice, buttons or links. The app and the web both map from this file and test against its fixture. Only stored values are coloured: mood and stress are whole numbers 1-5, sleep_hours steps of 0.5 (0-14), exercise_minutes one of 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90. Averages (e.g. Insights totals) are never coloured; a line chart gradient blends the five step colours along its value axis.

outline.note: The 1 px outline around every coloured circle (the muted token).
